SELECT c.id, c.news_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.root_comment_id, c.reply_to_comment_id, c.is_hidden, n.title, n.is_deleted news_deleted, n.publish_status, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment r WHERE r.root_comment_id = c.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_hidden = 0) reply_count,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id AND l.liked = 1) like_count FROM community_comment c LEFT JOIN cms_news n ON n.id = c.news_id WHERE c.user_id = #{viewer} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
